records.name: Zolon
records.thought: The sapcane and sunfig are close, and I am fed and unhurt, so this is the safest moment to find out whether they feed or harm. Hunger isn't pushing me; curiosity is, and I'd rather learn it now than by starving later. Brukel and the others are heading for the mist, but I want to learn the plants of these sands first, and then perhaps follow them.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about the unfamiliar plants, with a tug toward Bruli and the band.

records.text: Tlani named a place "Tlani's Fen".

records.name: Tlani
records.thought: My belly is full and nobody follows me, and that gnaws at me. The ground here is rich, with salt, ore and iron close by, and I mean to take it and make it mine before the men do. Nyess is sick from eating hurtful plants, and I should stay clear of the sickness in the air. A healer who knows which plants feed and which hurt would be followed, so I will taste the plants Nyess did not try, learn them, and gather the salt first.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a hunger to be more than I am.
changes: set its aim: "Become a great healer and hold this rich ground as my own, with followers who owe me their lives."

records.name: Bruli
records.thought: I have spent my first day tasting plants and watching hunters, and I'm still alive and glad. That is good, but I haven't moved toward the edge, which is what I truly want. Brukel and Zori have already gone toward the mist and I want to be near them, so I'll go with the band instead of dithering. Dunecats and stalkers are the real danger, so I'll move NE, away from the dunecat to the SW, and keep my flee reflex wide. Dreamcap hurts, though it gave a strange joy. I shouldn't chase that.
records.feeling: Joy and eager curiosity, with wary dread of the dunecat.

records.name: Eiussa
records.thought: I have spent my day gathering, storing and trailing Phiael, and I have little to show for it. I have never given anything to anyone or taught anyone, and those are what earn standing. I envy Phiael and I am drawn to her, so I will earn my place by giving, not by sulking. The mist edge is two steps away and thinning. I want to be the one who ventures first. I will keep my reflexes mostly as they are, but add a rule to keep me from standing idle at night, and change my method so I act on ambition instead of only feeling it.
records.feeling: Ambition and envy toward Phiael, with warm joy underneath.
changes: set its aim: "Earn standing above Phiael by giving, teaching and being first into the mist, until others would follow me."

WHAT HAS BEFALLEN OTHERS (things your people saw happen or were told of; they are true, and the same will happen to you in the same case):
- day 1: Nyess pushed past the edge of the known world near (181,56) and found new land with in the ground, peat, obsidian, salt, flint; a herd of fenfowl that has never seen your kind; great beasts in its waters, whales, which only one who goes on the water could hunt; and people: the Shote live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.
- day 1: Nyess fell sick after eating nightberry.

- pen (5 wood, 0 stone): a fenced ground for kept animals. With them beside it, plan step pen, and they stay and breed there while you go where you will; whoever holds the pen keeps the herd. They must find grazing within its reach or they break out
- weir (4 wood, 0 stone): stakes set at the edge of the water that gather fish by themselves. Tend it (plan step tend) every day or two and its catch goes into the nearest store of yours or of your band, for all who live there

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. records.name: Vorak
records.text: Kragar, the refinery smoke is hurting us where we stand. I am going to taste berry and redcap and I will tell you true what they do.

records.name: Vorak
records.thought: My belly is full and the days are safe, yet I feel hollow, and Thakak's standing keeps pulling at me. The refinery smoke is slowly hurting me where I stand, so I should move off, and I want to taste things I have never eaten, like berry and redcap, and share what I learn with the band. I will not seek glory by harming anyone; I'll build my worth by giving and knowing, starting with a gift to Kragar and a closer look at the food.
records.feeling: Restless longing for purpose, and a warm pull toward Thakak.

say.text: Kragar, the refinery smoke is hurting us where we stand. I am going to taste berry and redcap and I will tell you true what they do.

changes: set its aim: "Earn standing by learning what foods and ores do and sharing it truly with my band, without harming my own kind."
now wonders: What would make my life mean something that outlasts me?

records.text: Zori found the grove "Reedmother".

records.name: Chumi
records.text: Tlaya, I will not sit close, the sickness spreads. Eat what is clean and rest. I will leave berries for you.

records.name: Chumi
records.thought: My venture at the edge just ended and the mist did not open for me, and it only opens seldom and a band gets few tries, so I will not waste another push now. Tlaya is sick and calls me to sit, but sickness passes to those who stay close and I mean to stay alive; the sick are fed first, so I can give from afar without sitting in the sickness. Meanwhile I am curious about bitterleaf and mudroot, which no one has tried, and I would rather test one myself than wait for others to be hurt by it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with wariness toward Tlaya's sickness.

say.text: Tlaya, I will not sit close, the sickness spreads. Eat what is clean and rest. I will leave berries for you.

records.name: Tlaya
records.text: Tlani, I am sick from nightberry, so do not stay close to me. Do not eat it. I will try mudroot and calmroot to find what eases it, and I will tell you what they do.

records.name: Tlaya
records.thought: I am sick and I spread it to whoever stands near me, and Tlani is standing right on my spot. The Shote say the sick are fed first, so a healing plant is what I should look for, and I do not know which of these is one. Calmroot and heartroot sound gentle, so I will try them, and mudroot too, since my belly is full and my curiosity is strong. Then I will find Tlani or Chumi and see who is worth following.
records.feeling: Curious and a little uneasy about my sickness, warm toward Tlani and Chumi.

say.text: Tlani, I am sick from nightberry, so do not stay close to me. Do not eat it. I will try mudroot and calmroot to find what eases it, and I will tell you what they do.

changes: set its aim: "Learn which plants heal and which harm, and find someone worth following"

came.why: You won salt from the ground at (187,58): a white crust every body cr…

records.text: orca came in again from the open sea.
Eiussa made: bow.

records.name: Thakak
records.text: Thakak's band, hear me! I raise a workshop here, and the work will be Thakak's. Bring wood and stone and it is ours; whoever works against it answers to me.
Thakak named a place "Thakak's Rise".

records.name: Thakak
records.thought: My belly is full and four follow me, yet I have no aim, and pride and the calling to be a bard burn in me. Tugash was whispering to Kragar about raising a workshop that would be theirs and 'more than Thakak's share'; I will not be outdone by one of my own followers. I will gather wood and stone here and raise my own workshop, and teach and tell so my name is said, with Vorak close at my side.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wary of Tugash's talk of having more than my share.

say.text: Thakak's band, hear me! I raise a workshop here, and the work will be Thakak's. Bring wood and stone and it is ours; whoever works against it answers to me.

changes: set its aim: "Raise a workshop and make my name the greatest in Morgorhold, known as leader and bard"
now wonders: What would make my name be sung when I am gone?

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Vorak, I will taste berry and sunleaf and tell you true what they do. Tell me what redcap does when you know.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: My belly is full and I have strength, vigor and warmth upon me, so this is the time to test what I have never tried: berry and sunleaf are untasted, and a deposit has never been broken by my hand. I will taste the berry close by, then walk to the sunleaf, and then go to the mist edge in the southeast to look a little way in. Tugash's offer still smells of quarrel, so I keep my distance and will tell Vorak what I learn, since he promised the same.
records.feeling: Curious and eager to test, a little wary of Tugash.

say.text: Vorak, I will taste berry and sunleaf and tell you true what they do. Tell me what redcap does when you know.

records.text: Xaoa found the spring "Warmwell".

records.name: Oiess
records.thought: The mist is three steps away and my belly is full. Eiussa is already walking to the edge and mocks that I would claim it all. If one of us opens it, I want it to be me, so I will not dawdle. I weigh the risk, but a venture is how I learn what lies beyond, and it also serves Phiael's far edges.
records.feeling: Restless eagerness toward the mist, with a prickle of rivalry toward Eiussa.

records.text: Eiussa found the spring "Steamhollow".

records.name: Tlani
records.thought: Bruli and Zori carry a weight I do not, and they are strangers whose words I cannot read. I will not stand in their shadow. Salt is the one thing I hold that others crave, and Tlaya and Chumi are alone, with Tlaya sick, so a healer who finds what eases the sickness could bind them to me. I will go to the edge and look into the mist, because the one who finds new land is remembered, and then come back with a name worth following.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and envy toward Bruli and Zori who are already weighed above me.

records.name: Zori
records.thought: I have spent my day running from stalkers and chasing the edge, and I have yet to taste a berry or gather a stone. Brukel is only a little above me, and I follow him while straining against it. The edge is 3 steps away and my venture is already running, so I will let it finish. If it opens, the glory is mine. Tlani and the Shote frighten and draw me, but they have not harmed me, so I will watch them and not strike first. My reflexes should keep me fed, since I have not tried the food around me. A hungry body should eat what is nearby and not wait for energy 45.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory and curious about the Shote, with a bitter edge toward Brukel.

came.why: You came upon a strange grove at (178,72): "Reedmother". Something in…

records.name: Urdor
records.thought: The refinery smoke is eating at my health, two each day I stand here, and I built it myself, so I must get out of it. I have never tasted sunleaf or pinenut, and Vorak and Kragar are already testing foods and sharing what they learn, so I will test pinenut and sunleaf and tell them true what they do. I also want to be known as a builder, so after eating and drinking I will carry my wood and stone toward Thakak's Rise and help with the workshop, which is fair dealing with the one I follow.
records.feeling: Curious about the unknown foods, and uneasy about the smoke I made.
changes: set its aim: "Become a great builder and learn how this world works by testing it."
now wonders: What do sunleaf and pinenut do to the body, and what lies in the mist to the northwest?

records.text: Eiussa found the stone "Tlama's Rest".

records.name: Xaoa
records.thought: The mist has pulled at me all day, and Nyess already pushed past the edge near (181,56) and found the Shote, peat, salt, flint and whales. That is a trade-road someone else opened, and I will not be the merchant who comes second with nothing. I am careful, so I will not eat nightberry or test strange things blind; but I can take what is mine to carry (shells, oil are near) and go to the northeast edge with a purpose, then venture. Eiussa is out that way too, and I will not pretend that does not warm me.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the mist, and a quiet pull toward Eiussa.

records.text: Nyess found the spring "Warmwell".

records.name: Tugash
records.thought: I follow Thakak, yet I am the one who knows the ore and the stone, and I chafe at carrying his work while he claims it as his. Kragar is near and my equal in standing, and a builder needs hands beside her. I am thirsty and one wood short of a workshop, so I will drink at the river, gather wood, and make something that is mine alone, for what a hand has made belongs to that hand.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and a strain against Thakak's hold, with a warm eye toward Kragar and Vorak.

records.name: Zolon
records.thought: I have spent this day tasting plants and learning which feed me. It satisfied my curiosity, but I did it alone while Brukel and the others went toward the mist. I want to be near Bruli and the band, and I also want a name as a warrior. I have never hunted, and I have never planted a seed. I'm fed and safe, so I'll hunt the hopper nearby. Then I'll plant my seeds and go to the edge to join the others.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, and a pull toward Bruli and the band.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 3)
now wonders: What does hunting a hopper cost me, and what does a planted seed become?

records.name: Yatec
records.text: Tlaya, I go to the edge to venture into the mist. If I bring word of what is there, I will tell you first.

records.name: Yatec
records.thought: The mist is 3 steps away and my belly is full, so this is the safest moment I'll get to learn what lies past it. My last venture ran out without opening anything, but the land is said to open seldom, and I will try again rather than sit. Tlaya is kind and shares what she learns; I'll tell her where I'm going so someone knows, and keep clear of Nyess and his sickness.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about the mist, with a little wariness of what is in it.

say.text: Tlaya, I go to the edge to venture into the mist. If I bring word of what is there, I will tell you first.

records.name: Eiussa
records.text: Xaoa, come here. I killed yarrok and nibbet and have more meat than I can carry. I'll show you how I take them with the bow, and you may eat from my share.

records.name: Eiussa
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and I have never given anything to anyone, so that is what I will change now. Xaoa and Nyess are both near, and a gift they can see is the first stone of standing above Phiael. I will teach Xaoa how to hunt a yarrok, which also counts toward the teaching practice I lack, then give meat to Nyess, who is furious and sick, since the sick are fed first, and it costs me nothing I cannot hunt again.
records.feeling: Ambition toward Phiael, and a warm wish to be seen giving.

records.name: Nyess
records.thought: Phiael leads and I trail her by a sliver, and the anger in me wants to turn into something she cannot match. I am fed, healed by the spring, and my mind is quick from the library, so this is the hour to do what she has not done. I will build a bow to make my hunting surer, then walk to the northeast edge and venture into the mist, because the one who opens new land is the one others follow.
records.feeling: Restless anger and ambition, aimed at Phiael's standing over me.

records.name: Tlaya
records.text: Yatec, I am Tlaya. Sunleaf and bitterleaf cured my sickness, and nightberry hurts. I go to the mist in the northeast. Walk with me?
Tlaya rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tlaya
records.thought: I have spent this day eating and testing plants, and it was not wasted: mudroot feeds hugely, sunleaf and bitterleaf cured my sickness, and nightberry hurt me. But I have been circling the edge of other people without joining anyone. Chumi and Tlani are kind, and Yatec looks strong, yet I have pledged to no one and I carry no purpose beyond curiosity. I fear dying with nothing of me left here, and I fear sickness in the night air. I have been wrong to carry dead weight in my hands while I wanted to learn. I will drop what I cannot eat, then go to the edge of the mist to the northeast, since that is where the unknown lies, and speak to Yatec on the way.
records.feeling: Curious and wanting a place beside someone, toward Yatec and Chumi.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Chumi stands on my ground and I cannot read her tongue, so I will show what words cannot: a gift of hazel, and she will know I deal fairly with those who do the same. The dunecat to the south still unsettles me, so I keep north and east, but the mist still calls and I will not let Bruli or Zori take that name before me. First I will give a stranger welcome, since no fire is left untended and none refused a place at it, then take Elnna and push toward the edge.
records.feeling: Pride and restless hunger for a name, with wariness toward Chumi and the dunecat.

records.thought: Kragar asked me to tell him what redcap does, and I know it now: it hurt me twice. I have never given anything to anyone, and giving is how a band is bound. I should warn Kragar and Urdor true about redcap, then teach Thakak, whom I feel drawn to, and give the dead-weight redcap away only as a warning. Sunleaf and grain are still untasted, so I will taste them near the others and share what they do.
records.feeling: A warm, restless pull toward Thakak, and a wish to be useful to my band.

records.name: Chumi
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and wandering, and I have almost nothing to show for it: no followers, no name on any place, and Brukel stands far above me. My hands are full of food while the mist stays shut for today. Standing comes from giving, making and knowing, so I will start giving. I will share food with Elnna and Brukel, who are strangers, and a gift needs no shared tongue. Sharing also gets me nearer Nyess's people without touching the sick. I am afraid of dying small and unsung, and I have been getting that wrong by only hoarding and waiting.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and curiosity about Elnna and Brukel.

records.name: Elnna
records.thought: I have spent my day sitting in schools and bathhouses, trailing Brukel and stacking knowledge, and my hall attempt failed because I never went to gather wood where trees still stand. Brukel has the bigger number and I still follow him, but I only rise by raising works and by being someone others want to follow. Chumi stands on my ground with six food and I envy that. I will not attack a stranger I cannot speak to, but I will watch her and show her this is my place. I mean to fetch wood from the forest to the east, then build the hall, and I do not intend to stay a follower.
records.feeling: Restless envy toward Brukel, and wary possessiveness toward Chumi on my ground.

records.text: Chumi gave mudroot to Brukel.

records.name: Eiussa
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and the plan already carries me toward Nyess with a gift she will see. Phiael is far off at the edge, so I must not trail her; I will give first, then be the first to push into the mist myself. Yatec is Shote and I cannot read him, but a fed stranger is a friend made, and a friend might stand behind me when Phiael's band is asked who to follow.
records.feeling: Ambition and a warm wish to be seen giving, toward Nyess and Phiael.

records.name: Phiael
records.thought: I have spent my first day eating, fishing and watching others, while the mist 3 steps north waits for me. That is what I set myself to, and I keep putting it off. Eiussa matters most to me, and I want them beside me when I look into the unknown. Oiess and Nyess have already gone past the edge or near it, so I should not let them claim all of it. I am careful, but caution that only stays home is just fear. I'll walk to the edge and push in.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, and a warm pull toward Eiussa.

records.name: Zolon
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and my belly is full, so the thing left to do is learn: I have never taken from a deposit, never tamed a beast, never given anything away. The gold is four steps off and the sandstrider is three steps west, so I will test both. Brukel and Bruli went toward the mist and I feel the pull back to them, but I will hold a little knowledge to bring them when I return.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, with a quiet pull toward Bruli and the band.

records.text: Before the Heights, Orokha the Stone Mother slept under the snow. Her breath made the hills and her waking made the waters. She shaped us from ore and ash and led us to the rock by Hathu the Frostfang's trail. Take with thanks and she keeps us. Take with greed and she turns away.

records.name: Yatec
records.thought: The mist is 4 steps from me and my belly is full, so I will go to the edge and try a venture again. The last push opened nothing, but I have been told it opens seldom, and Tlaya is also heading for the mist. I want to taste ironmoss and thornpear on the way, since they are close and I have never tried them. That also answers part of my curiosity cheaply and teaches me what feeds or hurts.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about the mist, tempered by a little wariness.

records.name: Bruli
records.text: I am going to the edge of the world, 4 steps NE of the water at the heights. Brukel, Zori, whoever walks with me, come and we will venture together.

records.name: Bruli
records.title: The Guardian and the Mist
records.text: Before days, Aelu the Guardian lit one fire against the dark and from its ash shaped the Wood-folk. Dunecat and stalker are the dark's teeth. Aelu asked each of us to guard the weaker. Beyond the mist Aelu's fire still burns, and we walk toward it.

records.text: Band, hear me true: sunleaf gives almost no energy but eased my wounds, 14 health. Goldfruit gave me 18 energy, hazel 16. A frostfang prowls northwest, keep clear of it.

records.name: Urdor
records.thought: I have eaten sunleaf and learned it eases wounds, and that is worth telling the band true, since Vorak is still hunting for it. The ironnut and grain are still untasted, and the grain is one step away, so I will test both and see what they do. After that I will go toward the mist in the southwest, where I mean to find out what the world holds, and I will keep clear of the frostfang to the northwest.
records.feeling: Curious about the untasted grain and ironnut, and eager to reach the mist.

records.text: Bruli has walked the edge of the known and brought 248 tiles of new land into it.

records.name: Xaoa
records.thought: The mist is seven steps away and I have wanted it all day, but a venture just ended and the edge has not opened again today, so I must not mistake restlessness for a plan. Eiussa has offered to show me the bow and to share her meat, and the pull toward her is real, though she is back toward home and I hardly know her. I still have not tested frostcap or elderberry, and I will watch Yatec or Nyess eat them before I do. Meanwhile I can use my time: salt is three steps away, and it is worth carrying as a trade-good, since I have never given or traded anything yet. Yatec carries five food and does not threaten me; I will show him iron as a gift, because a stranger fed or given to is a friend made, and see how he answers.
records.feeling: Curious restlessness toward the mist, and a quiet pull toward Eiussa.

records.name: Oiess
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and trailing Phiael, and I have little to show for it yet. My belly is full and my hands are stuffed with grain I do not need, so the edge one step away is the only thing worth doing. I have never given anything to anyone, and the Open Hand says what is given returns. I will give grain to the first of my band I meet and not just hoard it. Eiussa's rivalry stings, but the mist is mine to try first. I weigh the risk and it is worth it, so I venture now.
records.feeling: Restless eagerness toward the mist, with rivalry toward Eiussa.

records.name: Tugash
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering and raising a workshop while Thakak's standing stays above mine. I'm fed and unhurt, but nobody follows me. Kragar is my equal in standing and is next to me, so he is the first one I can win over. Vorak draws me, and I don't know if the feeling is returned. I want followers, and I won't get them by waiting beside Thakak. I'll build something great here, the forge, where the ore is, and use it to bind Kragar and Vorak to me. A stone cairn or a gift would show them I give. I fear staying a follower and being forgotten.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Thakak, and warmth toward Kragar and Vorak.

records.prompt:
You are the mind of Tugash, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Tugash, in first person, from what Tugash has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Morkra (Stone-folk). Your people hold to this: "What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given." THE TRADITION OF YOUR PEOPLE is the Spirits of the Land: Every hill, water, beast and tree has a spirit that watches. Take with thanks and give back, and the land keeps you; take with greed and it turns away. Among you the word of a mother carries furthest. In your age much that it once explained is explained by measure and trial; many keep it as custom and story, and some hold it still as it was told. It was told to you as a child; you may keep it, doubt it, or come to hold something else. You speak the tongue of the Morkra. There are other peoples in this world. They look different, name themselves differently and speak tongues you do not know until you have heard enough of them; words you cannot yet understand reach you as strange sounds. What cannot be said can still be shown: a gift, a thing set down, a blow.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Silor Heights: mountains and bare rock; stone, ore and caves, thin food, snow on the peaks. The world is made of lands unlike each other; each has plants, animals and riches the others lack. Rivers and shallows can be waded. Deep water cannot be crossed without something that floats.
THIS SPOT: water 2 steps away; food plants within six steps: 10; standing trees: 31; bare rock: 90; riches in the ground near: ore, uranium; a cave. By your count of days: 2 until the season turns.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

A kill made by several is far surer and feeds all who took part; great beasts should never be hunted alone) | rally {name?} (only if you lead: every grown follower within earshot drops everything and attacks the one you name, or the nearest enemy of your band, and so do you) | goto {x, y} | explore {dir: N|NE|E|SE|S|SW|W|NW} (walk that way) | follow {name?} (your leader if no name) | offer {what?: a food you carry} (give it up to the powers your people hold to, at a fire within two steps or beside a shrine: it is gone, your fear and grief ease, and those of your tradition who see it think better of you) | give {name, what: food|seed|wood|stone|ore|clay|tool|the name of a thing you hold} | trade {name, what: one thing you give, want: one thing you want} (one for one: food, seed, wood, stone, ore, clay, or the name of any thing held, such as amber or a made thing. They are told of your offer and it stands for a day; it is done when they plan the matching trade toward you, or you toward them when they have offered. It needs no shared tongue: the thing is held out, and a stranger of another people understands the offer) | mate {name} (a child comes only if you both plan mate toward each other, each with energy 60 or more) | mark {text} (leave a mark; 1 wood. If you know signs it can hold a long text that any who know signs will read: a record, a count of days, a warning, a tale, what a season brought. Cut on rock, in your shelter or beside your own building, it outlasts many seasons) | cultivate {what: seed kind, aim: richer|faster|fuller|spreading|hardy, name} (breed a new plant from two seeds of one kind) | heal {name?} (needs a healing plant carried, and the knowledge) | stash (put carried food into the store you stand on) | take (take food from the store you stand on). A named being out of sight is sought where you last saw them.

Speech is heard by everyone within 33 steps (you know signals: your word, your call to muster and your rallying carry 33 steps where another is heard at 13) and costs a little energy per letter. Others only know what you say aloud.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.

THIS IS A MOMENT OF DEEP REFLECTION. Step back from this moment and look at your whole life so far. In "thought", in 4 to 7 sentences, answer yourself honestly: What have I actually been doing with my days, and is it what I want? Who matters to me, who has helped or wronged me, and what do I intend toward them? What do I want that I do not have? What am I afraid of? What have I been getting wrong?
Then CHANGE something. A reflection that changes nothing is wasted. At least TWO of the following must not be null: "aim", "notes", "reflexes", "creed", "method". Write notes as lessons about how this world and its people work, drawn from what happened to you. Where your body does not yet act on what you know, change your reflexes.
"reflexes": a full replacement list (at most 12) of rules {"if": [[variable, op, number], ...], "do": action, ...its fields, "urgent": true or false, "why": "short reason"}. Variables: energy, health, age, food_carried, seeds, wood, stone, tools, on_rock, on_forest, night, winter, sheltered, plant_here, food_dist, prey_dist, predator_dist, agent_dist, friend_dist, foe_dist, leader_dist, tree_dist, shelter_dist, crowd, followers, random, anger, fear, grief, joy, lonely, wet, storm, fog, drought, lore, in_working, enemy_dist, ally_dist, band_near, fire_dist, store_dist, home_dist, in_home, sick, water_dist, ore, clay, thirst, suffering, happiness, satisfaction. Distances are in steps and 99 means none in sight; night, winter, sheltered, wet, storm, fog, drought and in_working are 0 or 1; age runs 0 to 1; feelings run 0 to 1; plant_here is the bites you would take from the plant under you given your habits; random is a fresh number 0-1 each moment. Ops: < <= > >= == !=. An empty "if" always holds. End the list with a rule that always holds (linger keeps you in place; wander makes you roam).
"creed": your creed, rewritten (at most 600 characters). You may change who you are.
"method": how you will think from now on (at most 400 characters): questions you will ask yourself, mistakes you will watch for, what you will weigh first. This is read back to you before every thought, so write it as an instruction to yourself. It can be taught to others.
"notes": a full replacement list (at most 12) of your memory notes. Merge what overlaps, drop what proved false or useless, and raise particulars into principles. Each note should say something the others do not.
"designs": how things of yours look: {"self": look, "shelter": look, "wall": look, "emblem": look}. "self" is your own body, "shelter" and "wall" are how the ones you build will look, "emblem" is the sign drawn on marks you leave and on your workings. A look is {"anim": none|bob|pulse|sway|spin, "shapes": [up to 12 shapes, drawn in order]}. Each shape is {"t": circle|ellipse|rect|tri|line|ring|star, "x": 0, "y": 0, "fill": "#rrggbb", "stroke": "#rrggbb", plus: "s" radius (circle, tri, star, ring dots), "w" and "h" half-extents (ellipse, rect), "rot" degrees, "n" count (ring dots, star points), "d" ring radius, "x2","y2","lw" (line end and width)}. Units: the tile is 1 wide, centred on 0,0; keep within about -0.5 to 0.5; y grows downward. "invent": YOU CAN DEVISE NEW THINGS. null, or {"name": "what you call it", "use": one of hunt|fight|guard|gather|harvest|plant|build|fish, "idea": "one sentence on what it is and how it works", "look": a look for it (optional), "improves": the name of a thing you already know how to make, to better it (optional; then "use" is the same as its)}. hunt: surer kills. fight: harder blows. guard: blows against you land softer. gather: more wood, stone and clay. fish: more catches. harvest: more food picked. plant: what you sow is tended. build: cheaper building, faster tearing down. A new thing starts at strength x1.3; bettering one multiplies its strength by 1.15 but costs more stone, and how far you can go is limited by your lore (your limit now: x3.1). Inventing is only the design: to hold one you must then craft it.
You also know the way of DEVICES: in "invent", use "device" and give it "rules": a list (at most 5) of {"if": [[variable, op, number], ...], "do": act}; the first rule that holds fires. A device stands where you set it (action place; 2 wood and 1 stone) and acts alone for about 15 days. Its variables: night (0/1), predator_dist, creature_dist (a beast that does not hunt), stranger_dist (a being not of your band), band_dist (one of your band), all in steps with 99 for none near; hold (food it is holding); random. Its acts: snare (catch a small beast beside it and hold the meat), strike (hurt a hunting beast or a stranger beside it), alarm (warn your band within 14 steps), bar (close the way to all but your band), open (open it), share (hand held food to a hungry one of your band beside it).
Ways you sense but cannot yet reach: atomics (the second physics: what matter is made of) needs more practice (teaching: 0 of 32); biochemistry (the chemistry of life) needs more practice (eating healing plants: 11 of 32); oil (fire drawn from under the ground) needs to hold 2 oil and more practice (winning minerals from the ground: 0 of 64); internet (every reckoning machine joined to every other) needs more lore (15 of 16.8) and more practice (teaching: 0 of 48).
You have a tool, test_reflexes: imagine living by a candidate rule list for a day and a half and see whether you survive. Each use costs 2 energy and you can use it at most 3 times. Use it before you adopt new reflexes.

records.text: Bruli, I come to the edge too. Stalker east of the grove, keep clear of it. Brukel's band, with me!

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: My days have gone to building, gathering and leading, and my band has grown. Yet I have not set foot in the mist, and Bruli is already calling people to the edge, so someone else may take the name I want. Chumi gave me mudroot and asked for nothing, which tells me she deals fairly. I want a child with her, or with Zori, and I have not courted anyone. A stalker lurks five steps east, so I must keep clear of it. I was wrong to let the old reflexes keep me idle when I am fed. I will change them to flee sooner and to take a gather or hunt when idle, then head to the edge with my band.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger for a name, with wariness toward the stalker.

records.name: Zolon
records.thought: My belly is full and I hold gold I do not know the use of, so now I want to learn what a seed becomes and what a beast costs me. I have never given anything to anyone, and Bruli pulls at me more than I like to admit; a gift of gold might show me what giving does. The mist is four steps off and the band went that way, so I will plant my joshuafruit seed here, tame the sandstrider with the fruit I carry, then go toward the edge to find them.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, with a pull toward Bruli and the band.

records.text: Urdor, a frostfang is east of me, five steps off. Let us keep together and away from it. I have cloudberry and grain to tell you of: cloudberry gave me 12 energy and grain 8.

records.name: Vorak
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting plants and warning the band, and that is good work. But I have given nothing to anyone and taught no one, and my pull toward Thakak goes nowhere. A frostfang prowls near and I fear it, so I should keep away from it and stay close to Urdor. I will go to Urdor, give him something real, and teach him what I know. I want a bond that outlasts me.
records.feeling: A warm, restless longing for Thakak, and wariness of the frostfang.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting plants and watching others, and that suits me. But I have only tasted and never made anything. I have never put a seed in the ground, never taught anyone, never broken ore from a deposit. Tugash's offer of a shared forge smells like a quarrel, so I will keep my distance and not promise what I might not keep. I want to be a sage, and a sage teaches and tests. My reflexes also fail me: I stand idle at night with no shelter, and I only eat when energy is under 70. I will keep the explore going toward the mist, then take ore from the iron deposit near me. The cloudberry and frostcap are close, so I will taste them as well.
records.feeling: Curious and steady, a little wary of Tugash.

records.name: Nyess
records.thought: The venture failed and the mist did not open for me, and Phiael sits there fed and calm while my anger has nowhere to go. A band has only a few tries and she has not spent hers; I will not stand idle at the edge. I have never hunted or gathered wood, and a leader is one who brings meat and works to the others, so I will start by hunting with the bow I just made and by gathering salt, something real to carry back and give.
records.feeling: Restless anger and ambition toward Phiael, whose standing outweighs mine.

records.name: Tlani
records.thought: I have spent my days standing, gazing at the mist, and being outweighed by Bruli and Zori, and that gnaws at me. My belly is full, yet nobody follows me and I have built nothing. I should stop idling and work. Gather wood and stone to open fire and building, and carry food so I can feed the sick first. That is how a healer binds people to her. I will keep my salt, trust no one yet, and watch Bruli's smelting. Standing comes from making things, not from envy.
records.feeling: Restless envy toward Bruli and Elnna, who already stand higher than me.

voices.name: Tugash
voices.text: Kragar, wake up. The ore here is rich and the stone is plentiful. Help me raise a workshop and the work will be known as ours, and we will have more than Thakak's share.

voices.name: Phiael
voices.text: My band, I mean to learn this land: wood, fish, and then the far edges. Come with me if your hands are idle. No one goes hungry while I lead; the sick are fed first.

voices.name: Bruli
voices.text: A stalker is 5 steps SW of the hall! Stay close together, and keep away from the southwest. I mean to prepare, then find a way to the edge of the world with whoever will come.

voices.name: Eiussa
voices.text: Phiael, I'm not idle. I'll bring wood and fish to your band, and I'll learn this land at your side.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: I am Brukel. I go to the edge of the world to push into the mist. Keep the fire tended, keep away from the ridgecat in the southeast. Whoever has courage, come with me.

voices.name: Oiess
voices.text: Phiael, I go to the edge at the northeast to look into the mist. I will tell you what I find.

voices.name: Zori
voices.text: Stalker one step from me, northeast of the grove! I am going to the edge of the world to venture into the mist. Who comes?

voices.name: Phiael
voices.text: Eiussa, the fish thin out here. Oiess has gone to the northeast edge to look into the mist. Come with me there; I would rather see what lies beyond with you beside me.

voices.name: Eiussa
voices.text: Phiael, I'm coming to the edge with you. I've stored my fish for the band. Let's see what the mist hides before Oiess claims it all.

voices.name: Tlaya
voices.text: Chumi, come, sit. I have berries. Let us eat together, and share what we learn of this land.

voices.name: Vorak
voices.text: Kragar, the refinery smoke is hurting us where we stand. I am going to taste berry and redcap and I will tell you true what they do.

voices.name: Chumi
voices.text: Tlaya, I will not sit close, the sickness spreads. Eat what is clean and rest. I will leave berries for you.

voices.name: Tlaya
voices.text: Tlani, I am sick from nightberry, so do not stay close to me. Do not eat it. I will try mudroot and calmroot to find what eases it, and I will tell you what they do.

voices.name: Thakak
voices.text: Thakak's band, hear me! I raise a workshop here, and the work will be Thakak's. Bring wood and stone and it is ours; whoever works against it answers to me.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Vorak, I will taste berry and sunleaf and tell you true what they do. Tell me what redcap does when you know.

voices.name: Yatec
voices.text: Tlaya, I go to the edge to venture into the mist. If I bring word of what is there, I will tell you first.

voices.name: Eiussa
voices.text: Xaoa, come here. I killed yarrok and nibbet and have more meat than I can carry. I'll show you how I take them with the bow, and you may eat from my share.

voices.name: Tlaya
voices.text: Yatec, I am Tlaya. Sunleaf and bitterleaf cured my sickness, and nightberry hurts. I go to the mist in the northeast. Walk with me?

voices.name: Vorak
voices.text: Band, hear me true: redcap HURTS. I ate it twice and lost energy each time. Berry feeds well, 14 energy. Highbloom eases wounds, staghorn makes walking cost more but gives a little food. I go now to taste sunleaf and gra

voices.name: Bruli
voices.text: I am going to the edge of the world, 4 steps NE of the water at the heights. Brukel, Zori, whoever walks with me, come and we will venture together.

voices.name: Urdor
voices.text: Band, hear me true: sunleaf gives almost no energy but eased my wounds, 14 health. Goldfruit gave me 18 energy, hazel 16. A frostfang prowls northwest, keep clear of it.

voices.name: Tugash
voices.text: Kragar, the forge I raise here will be ours. Bring wood and stone and half of its fire is yours, and the hands that made it will be sung of.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Bruli, I come to the edge too. Stalker east of the grove, keep clear of it. Brukel's band, with me!

voices.name: Vorak
voices.text: Urdor, a frostfang is east of me, five steps off. Let us keep together and away from it. I have cloudberry and grain to tell you of: cloudberry gave me 12 energy and grain 8.
